confidence_notes: Food anchors are based on Boracay price-index data near the July 2026 window. Drink prices vary by venue; cocktail and wine estimates use the tourist-bar premium relative to domestic draft beer, with wine especially uncertain. Accommodation anchors are broad estimates; July rain-season demand and property location can shift prices substantially.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Boracay-specific data; accommodation uses a broad Philippine resort-island guesthouse and hotel basis.
